children: Indonesia has set its September crude palm oil reference price at $1,007.51 per metric ton, a trade ministry regulation showed on Monday.
The new reference price would keep the export tax for crude palm oil next month unchanged at $148 a ton. Indonesia also imposes a separate 12.5% export levy on crude palm oil.
